items.description:
Norse Studios is a Doornpoort-based creative and digital agency established in 2022. The studio works across three core areas: brand development, web and digital services, and business technology. Its brand development offering covers brand identity, visual direction and graphic design, helping businesses build recognisable identities from the ground up. On the digital side, Norse Studios builds websites, hosting arrangements and other online platforms designed around each client's business needs. Its business technology arm extends into business applications and ERP concepts, aimed at helping operations run more efficiently through practical digital tools.

The studio describes its approach as valuing clarity before cleverness, aiming to turn ideas into brands, websites and digital systems that are easy for people to understand and remember. It positions its work as creative output backed by practical technology, serving a range of different businesses with identity systems, brand strategy and brand assets as well as websites built to work as hard as the business itself. Norse Studios frames its working culture around three values: humility in how it works, courage in what it creates, and loyalty to the people who trust it.

Based in Doornpoort, Pretoria, the studio is positioned to serve businesses across the wider Pretoria area with its combined design and technology services.

Nova Craft is an online and retail supplier in Erasmia, Centurion, specialising in solar and backup power equipment alongside auto accessories and homeware. Its backup and alternate power range covers solar panels, inverters, batteries and inverter-and-battery kits, along with smaller components such as MC4 solar branch connectors, DC knife fuses, mini DC UPS units and solar lighting, including indoor/outdoor solar ceiling lights and solar flood lights. Nova Craft also stocks larger hybrid inverter and battery backup systems, aimed at households and businesses wanting reliable power during outages. Beyond power equipment, the business sells auto accessories, including car air fresheners and car care products, as well as homeware items such as heaters and gas-powered countertop appliances.

The company runs periodic sales on its backup and solar range, discounting inverters and solar equipment by up to 15%. Operating from Erasmia, on the western side of Centurion, Nova Craft serves customers across the greater Centurion and Pretoria area looking to set up or expand home or business backup power solutions, combining solar generation, battery storage and inverter technology with the accessories needed for a complete installation.

Ntloedibe Attorneys Inc is a Mayville-based law firm made up of a team of attorneys who aim to treat every client as family and build long-term relationships with them. The firm's stated aim is to ensure client satisfaction, both as a way of working and as its core business process, and it frames its own success as tied directly to how successful its clients become. Its objective is the prompt delivery of high-quality legal services, drawing on innovation and sound technique in pursuit of effective legal protection for each client, built on a foundation of trust between attorney and client. The firm positions itself as service-driven, customer-focused, competitive and proactive, and says it has worked to remain flexible and adaptive to the varying cultures and needs of the Mayville community it serves.

Internally, Ntloedibe Attorneys describes a participative and innovative management style, with an emphasis on creating a healthy environment where individual staff can strive for excellence, alongside honest, frank two-way communication and loyalty to the business. The firm also produces a newsletter every three months to keep clients updated. Based on Mansfield Avenue in Mayville, the practice draws on a team of experienced and diverse lawyers committed to providing professional legal assistance to its clients.

Ornecy is a Centurion-based provider of integrated HR, payroll and custom software solutions, operating from Heuwelsig Office Park in Celtisdal. The company positions itself as a single, connected platform bringing together HR, payroll and bespoke applications, so organisations can manage their people and processes from one source rather than juggling multiple systems. Its payroll offering covers outsourced payroll services, while its human resources arm handles end-to-end employee lifecycle management. Ornecy also undertakes software development work, building flexible applications to meet varying client requirements, and offers consulting services spanning compliance, operational and strategic technical advice. Within its HR platform, Ornecy's modules include organisational management with dynamic reporting charts, health and safety tools, talent management for monitoring employee performance and development, HR operations for policy and compliance tracking, associate services for secure employee information and document administration, employee relations management, compensation and benefits decision support, time and attendance tracking for leave and absences, and a learning academy for administering training.

The platform is designed to be accessed securely around the clock from anywhere, letting organisations manage their workforce remotely. Based in Centurion, Ornecy serves organisations looking to consolidate HR, payroll and software needs into one coordinated system.

P-Wise Projects is a multidisciplinary construction and project management company based in Montana Park, Pretoria, covering the full project lifecycle from conception through procurement modelling to construction management and subsequent operation. The company positions its ability to design, manage and deliver projects efficiently and cost-effectively as a key differentiator in the market. Its service range spans bulk water reticulation network work, building maintenance and construction, plumbing services, electrical services, steel works and reinforcement, paving, and infrastructure and road projects, as well as waste management and grass-cutting services. P-Wise Projects also carries industry accreditations supporting its construction and project-management work. Past project examples referenced by the company include building maintenance and construction work as well as mall refurbishment projects, reflecting experience across both infrastructure and commercial-property type work.

Operating out of Montana Park, the company serves clients needing coordinated delivery across design, procurement and on-site construction management, rather than offering a single trade in isolation. Its combination of water, electrical, plumbing, steel and civil infrastructure capabilities allows it to take on multi-stage projects where several disciplines need to be managed together under one contractor, from initial planning right through to completed, operating infrastructure.

PEP Home Gezina Galleries is a PEP Home store trading from Shop 37 in Gezina Galleries, on the corner of Michael Brink and Frederika Streets in Gezina, Pretoria. As a PEP Home format store, it focuses on household goods and homeware rather than the clothing range carried by standard PEP stores, giving shoppers in the Gezina area a dedicated outlet for home products. The store keeps extended trading hours through the week, opening from 09:00 to 18:00 Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 15:00 on Saturdays, and 09:00 to 14:00 on Sundays, making it accessible for both weekday and weekend shopping trips.

Gezina Galleries sits among a cluster of other PEP and PEP Home branches across Pretoria, reflecting the brand's dense footprint of neighbourhood stores across the city. For residents of Gezina and surrounding suburbs, the Gezina Galleries branch offers a nearby option for homeware purchases without needing to travel into central Pretoria, fitting into daily shopping routines alongside grocery and other retail visits to the same centre.

PEP, in Checkers Centre, Lotus Gardens, is a clothing and general merchandise store trading from Shop 10 on the corner of Ruth First Street and Joe Modise Road. The store follows an extended weekly trading schedule, opening from 08:30 to 17:30 Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 14:00 on Saturdays, and 09:00 to 13:00 on Sundays, giving Lotus Gardens shoppers a consistent seven-day option for affordable clothing and household basics. Positioned inside the Checkers Centre, the store sits alongside a grocery anchor, making it a convenient stop for shoppers already visiting the centre for their weekly food shopping.

The Lotus Gardens branch forms part of a wider network of PEP stores across Pretoria, each operating broadly similar trading hours and stock ranges, which gives residents of Lotus Gardens and neighbouring areas reliable access to the retailer's affordable clothing, footwear and household items without having to travel into Pretoria's central shopping districts. Its position within a community shopping centre anchored by a supermarket means it benefits from regular day-to-day foot traffic from local residents running other errands in the same complex.

Olievenhout Plaza sits at a well-travelled corner along the R55, a route that links several residential areas around Centurion and Olievenhoutbosch, putting the store within easy reach of commuters as well as local residents doing everyday shopping.

For residents of Olievenhoutbosch, the branch offers a nearby alternative to travelling into central Centurion for basic clothing and household needs, fitting into routine shopping trips to the wider Olievenhout Plaza centre.

Perfect Peaks Roof Waterproofing is a Die Wilgers-based contractor offering roof waterproofing and repair services across Pretoria and Johannesburg, for both residential and commercial properties. Its core offering is roof waterproofing designed to form a protective barrier against moisture, keeping roofs resistant to rain, sun and general weathering. For concrete flat roofs, the company applies torch-on roof protection, a heat-fused membrane finished with a silver aluminium coat to guard against UV damage. Perfect Peaks also carries out roof painting, applying a durable protective layer that shields roofs from UV rays, moisture and debris while refreshing their appearance, and handles roof repairs and maintenance, including replacing rotted timber, cracked tiles and torn sheeting, as well as flashing installation and replacement. Beyond the roof itself, the company offers gutter maintenance and installation to help drain water away from buildings and prevent water damage, along with barge and fascia board work to seal the gaps between roof and wall.

The business offers free on-site quotes and describes its pricing as competitive without compromising on quality of workmanship or materials. Based on Harrop-Allin Avenue in Die Wilgers, Perfect Peaks serves homeowners and businesses across the greater Pretoria and Johannesburg region needing roof protection or repair.

Pizza Perfect Magalieskruin is a branch of the Pizza Perfect chain, trading from Magalieskruin Shopping Centre on Braam Pretorius Street. Pizza Perfect has been making pizzas since 1989 and has grown into a nationwide franchise with more than 100 wood-fired pizza takeaway stores across South Africa. The Magalieskruin branch serves the group's wood-fired pizza range, drawing on menu formats that span a standard pizza and chicken menu, a pizza and chicken wings menu, a halaal menu and an express menu, giving customers a choice depending on dietary needs or how quickly they want their order. Orders can be placed for collection or delivery through the Pizza Perfect app or website, in keeping with the group's wider online ordering system used across its stores.

As part of a long-established franchise network, the Magalieskruin branch benefits from recipes and wood-fired cooking methods refined over more than three decades of operation, while functioning as a local takeaway point within its own shopping centre. Positioned inside Magalieskruin Shopping Centre, the branch forms part of the everyday food options available to residents of Magalieskruin and nearby Pretoria suburbs, alongside the centre's other retailers.

items.description:
Pools & Renovators is a swimming pool renovation and maintenance business operating from a pool shop in Villieria, Pretoria, with more than 40 years of experience servicing pool owners across the greater Pretoria area, including Pretoria East and Centurion. The company focuses on pool repairs, fixing pool leaks, and renovating or rebuilding existing pools, alongside weekly pool maintenance and the construction of new pools. It specialises in fibreglass and concrete pools finished with marbelite, and also carries out sand filter changes, pool pump repairs and replacements, and the replacement of pool cleaner parts. Alongside traditional pool work, Pools & Renovators supplies and installs solar pool pumps, allowing a pool pump to run directly off solar power; the company positions this as a way to cut electricity costs, keep pumps running during load-shedding, and reduce environmental impact.

Its client base spans private homeowners, clubs and fitness centres, and the company also maintains a number of council-owned public pools across Pretoria. Teams working from the Villieria pool shop travel out daily to service pools across Pretoria's Moot area, Pretoria East and Centurion, combining established renovation expertise with newer solar-pump offerings for customers looking to reduce running costs on their existing pools.

PostNet EcoPark trades from Shop 15 in the Eco Boulevard Shopping Centre on Witch-Hazel Avenue in EcoPark Estate, Centurion. The store is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00 and Saturdays from 09:00 to 13:00, and is closed on Sundays and public holidays. As a PostNet branch, it offers a broad range of printing and courier services, including A4 and A3 printing, wide-format and plan printing, business cards, photo printing, name badges and rubber stamps, alongside convenience stationery and packaging material for customers preparing items to send. On the courier side, the branch handles both domestic and international shipping, including PostNet-to-PostNet and PostNet-to-door deliveries at overnight, non-express and economy service levels domestically, as well as international options such as PostNet Global Express and DHL Express, along with excess baggage shipping and optional insurance cover for parcels. The store also provides a range of digital services typical of PostNet branches, including internet stations, credit report requests, email services and fax-to-email facilities.

Positioned inside the Eco Boulevard centre, the EcoPark branch serves residents and businesses in the EcoPark Estate area of Centurion with a single stop for printing, postal and courier needs.

Pretoria buses to Zimbabwe Bosman Station operates as a cross-border coach departure point in Salvokop, from which several bus operators run services between Pretoria and Harare, Zimbabwe. Departures leave from locations around the Bosman Station precinct, including the Bosman Coach Station Terminus and Bosman Station CBD on Paul Kruger Street, with multiple services running each day to Harare's Roadport terminal. Journey times on the route vary by operator, generally running from around eighteen to just over twenty-one hours depending on the service chosen, with fares that have ranged from roughly R850 up to around R1,080 depending on departure time and operator. Buses on this corridor typically offer amenities such as onboard toilets, with some services also providing wifi and power outlets for passengers on the long overnight or daytime journey north. Multiple operators compete on the Pretoria-to-Harare route from Bosman Station, giving travellers a choice of departure times throughout the day, from mid-morning through to evening departures.

As one of the main cross-border coach departure points in Pretoria, Bosman Station in Salvokop serves as a hub for passengers travelling to Zimbabwe, connecting the South African capital directly with Harare without requiring a change of bus along the way.

Pretoria Sheet Metal Works is a sheet-metal fabrication contractor operating from Pretoria Street in the Booysens/Daspoort area of Pretoria. Listed under the sheet-metal work trade, the business is known in Afrikaans directories by the term 'Plaatmetaalkontrakteur', reflecting its focus on metal plate fabrication and related contracting work. The company keeps standard weekday trading hours, open from 07:45 to 16:15 Monday to Thursday and from 07:45 to 14:15 on Fridays, with the workshop closed over weekends.

Operating as a dedicated sheet-metal contractor rather than a general metalwork supplier, the business serves builders and contractors around Pretoria needing custom fabrication and finishing work carried out to order. Its position within Pretoria's established industrial and manufacturing precinct places it close to other metalwork and engineering businesses in the surrounding area, making it a convenient option for trade clients already sourcing materials or services nearby. With defined weekday hours and a long-standing presence in the Booysens/Daspoort area, Pretoria Sheet Metal Works operates as a traditional, trade-focused fabrication workshop rather than a retail-facing business, serving clients who need sheet-metal components produced to specification for building and construction projects.

Prime Auto Glass is a windscreen repair and replacement business based on Rachel de Beer Street in Pretoria North, offering both mobile callouts and a fixed fitment centre for customers across the area. The company follows a repair-first approach, recommending a chip or crack be repaired rather than the windscreen replaced wherever it can be done safely, aiming to save customers time and unnecessary cost. Where replacement is necessary, Prime Auto Glass uses SABS-approved glass together with SAWRA-approved adhesives, intended to ensure correct installation and maintain the structural integrity of the vehicle.

The business describes itself as newly established, built specifically in response to seeing customers experience unnecessary replacements, poor communication and rushed workmanship elsewhere in the auto-glass industry, with an aim of doing the job right the first time. Its technicians bring more than 13 years of hands-on auto-glass experience to that newer business structure. Customers can choose between having a technician come to them through the mobile service or visiting the fitment centre directly, depending on which is more convenient. The company positions its combination of national-brand-quality materials with a locally based, personally accountable service as its main point of difference from larger chains operating in the Pretoria North area.

Pro-IT, trading as 'Your Technology Partner', is an IT services company based in Annlin, Pretoria, offering a range of support aimed at both small businesses and individual customers. Its core services include network cabling, specialising in CAT 6 installations, along with network troubleshooting and optimisation to keep connections reliable and efficient. The company also provides managed IT services, covering proactive monitoring, fast issue resolution and strategic IT planning, drawing on more than 20 years of combined experience to help reduce downtime and improve operational efficiency for clients. On the cloud side, Pro-IT supports Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform and Office 365 environments, assisting clients with scalable storage, collaboration tools and secure data management. The company additionally offers domain registration and web hosting, CCTV installation and structured cabling, and hardware support for troubleshooting desktops, laptops and servers.

Pro-IT markets itself with the tagline 'Lekker IT for Lekker People', positioning itself as an approachable, locally based alternative to larger national IT providers for businesses in and around Annlin. Clients needing support across networking, cloud migration, security cabling or day-to-day hardware issues can draw on this combined service range from a single, Annlin-based technology partner.

Proper Document Storage is a records-management business based on Lanham Street in East Lynne, Pretoria, helping companies manage physical and digital document storage. The company works with businesses that are either moving toward paperless operations or looking to optimise their existing storage capacity, given the volume of data organisations generate for internal use and client projects, some of which is sensitive and needs to remain both accessible and securely stored. Proper Document Storage offers a turn-key records-management service, covering document storage, scanning and digitisation to convert paper records into digital form, secure document shredding, and full archiving services that can take a client's records right through to final, secure destruction.

The company positions outsourced physical document management as a way for businesses to save time and office space while also improving overall efficiency and security around their records. By handling the full life cycle of a document, from the point it is created or received through to its eventual destruction, Proper Document Storage aims to give East Lynne and wider Pretoria-area businesses full traceability over their records at every stage, reducing the operational burden of managing growing volumes of physical and digital information in-house.

PS Bushings is a Gezina/Eloffsdal-based manufacturer specialising in polyurethane suspension bushings for the automotive aftermarket. Polyurethane is recognised as a higher-durability alternative to standard OEM rubber suspension bushes, typically lasting around three times longer, and PS Bushings backs its products with a lifetime warranty, excluding spring bushes. The company has supplied the independent aftermarket in South Africa, and internationally, for more than 20 years, producing bushings designed to fit a wide range of vehicle brands, including Audi, Chevrolet, Chrysler, Citroën, Daihatsu, Fiat, Ford, Foton, Honda and Hyundai, among others. To support fitment, PS Bushings provides installation videos alongside its product range, helping workshops and individual customers fit the bushings correctly.

Rather than selling only through its own premises, the company has built a network of distributors spread across South Africa, with stockists in locations including Polokwane, Tzaneen, Port Elizabeth, Matatiele, Kokstad, the KwaZulu-Natal Midlands, Vryheid and Bloemfontein, extending its reach well beyond Pretoria. This distributor network allows workshops and vehicle owners around the country to access PS Bushings products locally rather than ordering directly from its Pretoria manufacturing base, while the Eloffsdal operation remains the source of its polyurethane bushing production.

Quick-Mix Ready-Mix Donkerhoek supplies ready-mix concrete and concrete pumping services from its plant on Bronkhorstspruit Road in Donkerhoek, Pretoria East, as part of the wider Quick-Mix Ready-Mix Concrete network. The company designs and tests its concrete to specification for project engineers, validating trial mixes before full-scale delivery begins and running compressive strength tests on its product, with batch records available for all loads produced at its plants. Its standard concrete range covers grades from 10 to 40 MPa for general applications, proportioned at roughly 70 percent cement to 30 percent cement extender, with a choice of 13mm or 19mm stone as the coarse aggregate depending on the application, and fly ash used as an extender to improve durability and workability of the fresh concrete. For projects requiring pumped delivery, Quick-Mix also offers concrete pump mixes rated from 10 to 45 MPa, engineered for high workability with a slump of between 100mm and 160mm, using a higher proportion of fine aggregates to achieve a low-viscosity, homogeneous paste suited to pumping.

The Donkerhoek plant operates extended weekday hours, running from 06:00 to 20:00 Monday to Friday and 06:00 to 13:00 on Saturdays, to accommodate construction schedules across Pretoria East.

Rakwena Properties is a 100% black-owned real estate agency based in Pretoria North, specialising in residential property sales across the Akasia area, including Amandasig, Karenpark, The Orchards, Ninapark and Theresapark, as well as Soshanguve. The agency's stated mission is to provide service built on integrity and honesty, acting in the best interests of both buyer and seller in every transaction it handles. Beyond listing homes for sale, Rakwena Properties offers a property finder service, actively searching for a buyer's ideal property rather than limiting them to its own current listings, and a market estimate service that gives property owners an indication of what their home could be worth if they were considering selling. The agency maintains an active book of residential listings across its focus suburbs, ranging from smaller starter homes to larger family houses, reflecting demand across different parts of the Akasia and Soshanguve property markets.

Operating from Pretoria North, Rakwena Properties positions its black ownership and local area focus as a point of difference from larger, broader-footprint agencies, aiming to build close knowledge of the specific suburbs it serves. Buyers and sellers in Amandasig, Karenpark, Ninapark, Theresapark and Soshanguve therefore have a locally focused agency option through Rakwena Properties.

items.description:
SABTEC Consulting is a Lyttelton Manor-based provider of consulting and training services centred on SAP and SUSE technology. The company's consulting work spans several SAP-related disciplines, including BASIS administration, ABAP development, system monitoring, integration work and SAP HANA, alongside cloud services and Linux-focused security consulting. On the training side, SABTEC runs structured courses covering SUSE Linux Enterprise deployment and administration, including SUSE Linux Enterprise Server deployment training, as well as newer offerings such as Kubernetes administration training built around SUSE's RKE2 platform, listed under the course code RKE201v2. This combination of SAP consulting and SUSE/Linux training lets SABTEC serve two related but distinct client needs: businesses running SAP environments that need specialist BASIS, ABAP, HANA or integration support, and IT teams needing formal, structured training in SUSE Linux Enterprise and container orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes.

Based in Kloofsig, Centurion, the company positions itself at the intersection of enterprise SAP systems and the Linux infrastructure that increasingly underpins them, offering both hands-on consulting engagements and scheduled training courses rather than one service alone. Clients working with SAP landscapes or SUSE-based infrastructure can draw on SABTEC for either ongoing technical consulting support or dedicated staff training on these systems.

Samba Solutions is a financial and audit services firm based in Hazeldean Office Park on Silverlakes Road, offering internal audit, external audit, tax and advisory services to small and medium-sized businesses. The company was founded in 2018 and has since built a presence across South Africa through these core service lines, aiming to combine transparency with quality in how it delivers financial and audit work. Samba Solutions describes its management team as bringing a track record of excellence to the business, alongside a stated commitment to youth empowerment within the finance and audit industry. On its own account, the firm has worked with more than 120 clients and completed over 127 projects since its founding, supported by a team of more than 23 trained staff. Its service lines cover consulting services, accounting services and internal audit work, giving clients a combined offering that spans both compliance-focused audit and tax work and more general financial advisory support.

Operating from its Hazeldean base, Samba Solutions positions itself as a Pretoria-founded firm that has grown a national client footprint over its first several years in business, built specifically around internal and external audit, tax and advisory services for SME clients.

Samcro Consulting & Services (Pty) Ltd is a business consultancy based in Wapadrand, Pretoria, built around four core service lines: payroll and bookkeeping, recruitment, compliance, and internship onboarding. Its payroll and bookkeeping service focuses on accurate financial record-keeping and management for client businesses, while its recruitment service aims to connect local businesses with suitable talent for open roles. On the compliance side, Samcro works to help businesses meet relevant legal and regulatory requirements and manage associated risk, and its internship-onboarding service supports businesses bringing interns into their organisation, helping manage that onboarding process.

The company describes its approach as solution-driven, aiming to guide client businesses toward sustainable growth through attention to detail, efficiency gains and a focus on quality service delivery across each of its service lines. By combining payroll, recruitment, compliance and internship support under one consultancy, Samcro Consulting & Services positions itself as a single point of contact for several related but distinct back-office and HR functions, rather than requiring businesses to engage separate specialists for each. Based in Wapadrand, the firm serves local businesses looking to outsource some or all of these functions as they grow.

Scheffer Accountants is a Doornpoort-based accounting practice that has provided tax and accounting services since 2006, working with both businesses and individuals. The practice specialises in tax and accounting services for small business corporations, alongside personal income tax work for individual clients. Its core offerings include business tax services, personal tax returns, payroll services, bookkeeping services and VAT services, covering the day-to-day compliance needs of smaller businesses. Scheffer Accountants also assists clients with registrations required by SARS and the Department of Labour, handles CIPC annual return submissions required in a company's registration month, and can issue a Letter of Good Standing for COID purposes. The practice helps clients obtain tax clearance certificates once their returns and tax obligations are up to date with SARS, and compiles financial statements within the required six months after a company's year end, as required of a qualified accountant.

By combining registration support, ongoing bookkeeping and payroll administration, and statutory filings such as CIPC returns and financial statements under one practice, Scheffer Accountants aims to cover the full range of compliance obligations facing small businesses and individual taxpayers in the Doornpoort and wider Pretoria area.

Sedgars Home is a furniture and home-decor retailer trading from Menlyn Retail Park, offering ranges across living room, dining room and bedroom furniture, as well as occasional chairs, tables and stands, and furniture suited to apartment-style living. The retailer positions its ranges as avant-garde and contemporary, describing its furniture and lifestyle items as comfortable, fashionable and largely exclusive to the Sedgars brand, combining imported pieces with locally crafted furniture. In-store, Sedgars Home offers consultative service from staff described as knowledgeable about the ranges on display, intended to help customers choose pieces to suit their homes rather than simply browsing stock unassisted. The retailer also emphasises the quality of textiles used across its upholstered ranges, saying time is taken to source materials built to last.

Beyond its physical Menlyn Retail Park showroom, Sedgars Home offers countrywide delivery, extending its furniture ranges to customers outside the immediate Pretoria area who are not able to shop in person. Its product range spans bedroom suites, dining room suites and chairs, and lounge suites, giving customers a broad single-brand option when furnishing multiple rooms at once, rather than needing to combine furniture from several different retailers.

Senic Accounting and Consulting Services is an accounting and consulting practice based in La Montagne, Pretoria, operating as a subsidiary of Senic Enterprises (Pty) Ltd since the practice came into existence on 22 February 2016. As part of a larger group, the practice draws on a range of expertise areas within Senic Enterprises to meet the varied and individual needs of its client base, rather than operating as a single, standalone accounting office. Its stated vision is to become a leading provider of accounting and consulting services for small to medium-sized businesses, built around a practical, personalised and focused approach to client delivery. The firm's mission centres on building professional, long-term relationships with clients, providing both assurance services, such as reviews and audits, and non-assurance services, such as bookkeeping and advisory work, at competitive prices, while maintaining compliance with industry practice and good governance requirements.

Senic places particular emphasis on taking time to understand each client's business and the specific challenges it faces, and on keeping its own staff up to date through ongoing education and training in the financial services sector. Operating from La Montagne, the practice positions itself as a group-backed but locally accessible accounting and consulting option for smaller Pretoria businesses needing both compliance and advisory support.
